thread:
matt_sales: Heads-up — SolarWind wants to run a 14B finetuned model for a POC next week. Can we do a quick compatibility + infra sanity check?

rachel_engineer: @matt_sales which model exactly? any custom tokenizer/ops?

matt_sales: model id they gave: `sw-14b-ft-v3`. small fine-tune, but uses llama-tokenizer-v2 and a custom ngram postproc. POC traffic expected ~10 qps.

jordan_sre: 10 qps steady for 14B is fine if we reserve Dedicated capacity, but need to confirm memory/kv cache profile. If they're using KV reuse, latency improves.

liz_solutions: Also flagged KMS/enterprise entitlements in the questionnaire — they need HSM-backed keys and audit logs. We need to check Private deployment options and cost delta.

rachel_engineer: quick compatibility checklist: 1) tokenizer -> convert or map tokens to Redwood runtime. 2) any custom ops -> must be in our kernel set or we need shim (slow). 3) quantization path — do they accept int8?

matt_sales: they said "lossless-quality prioritised" so probably not int8. Will confirm.

jordan_sre: If no quantization, plan: A100-80GB x2 with autoscaling headroom. Recommend dedicated pool with burst to hosted for spikes. Also need to confirm sequence length — POC prompts avg ~1024, max 2048?

liz_solutions: From security side: questionnaire item 12 wants VPC-only with customer-managed KMS + per-request audit. Private deployment (VPC) OK for them but timeline is longer.

rachel_engineer: If they insist on no-quant and custom tokenizer, we should propose a compatibility adapter: small conversion job to map tokenizer to runtime-compatible vocab + a wrapper layer. POC plan: one-off conversion + smoke tests.

matt_sales: Can you estimate ops/time/cost so I can scope in SOW?

jordan_sre: Rough: conversion + tests ~2 engineer-days. Dedicated infra provisioning + infra runbook + HSM setup ~5 days (inc. security review). Monthly infra commit estimate: ~$12k-$18k depending on reserved hours.

liz_solutions: Legal/Security: need to run their security questionnaire answers by compliance. Also need an SLA addendum for Private deploy. I'll start the T&Cs thread.

rachel_engineer: Tech risks: custom ops -> high risk (blocks fast onboarding). Tokenizer mapping -> medium risk but usually one-time. KMS/HSM -> operational lead required.

matt_sales: OK. Action items: @rachel_engineer create a small adapter PR template and checklist. @jordan_sre give a provisioning runbook + exact GPU SKU + networking notes. @liz_solutions start security + SOW language. I'll confirm whether they can accept int8 as fallback.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: note created: ticket #SW-POC-402 in infra backlog.

rachel_engineer: Will draft adapter checklist today. Snippet for testing harness:
```
# test harness snippet
MODEL_ID=sw-14b-ft-v3
SEQ=1024
BATCH=2
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/generate -d '{"model":"'$MODEL_ID'","input":"test prompt"}'
```

jordan_sre: Also adding perf target: p95 < 250ms for 1-token continuation at 10 qps. If we need lower, we recommend KV prefix caching and a smaller context window.

liz_solutions: I'll flag the HSM requirement to compliance. If they accept KMS with customer KMS (not HSM) we can shorten timeline by ~3 days and reduce cost.

matt_sales: Great. I'll sync with the customer and push back on int8 and KMS options. Update thread once I hear back. :thumbsup:

rachel_engineer: ack. I'll attach the adapter checklist to ticket #SW-POC-402.

ops-bot: ticket #SW-POC-402 updated: assignees set [rachel_engineer, jordan_sre, liz_solutions].

matt_sales: Thanks all — closing this sync for now, will reopen if they accept changes.
